confidence_notes: The prices for coffee, beer and inexpensive meals come from one web search of aggregated, user-submitted cost-of-living data (MyLifeElsewhere): cappuccino about 2.03 USD, local beer about 2.42 USD, inexpensive meal about 7.46 USD. That source's figures are a little inconsistent and are not dated to July 2026, so the values were rounded slightly up for summer pricing and inflation. The mid-range meal for two is an estimate scaled from the inexpensive meal. Cocktail (caipirinha) and wine-by-the-glass prices were not searched; they are estimated from the local beer price at roughly 3.5 to 4 times beer, which is less certain. The accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge. They reflect July being off-peak winter season in Florianópolis, when rates are well below the Dec–Feb peak. No accommodation listings were checked. The FX rate is the RBA 4pm reference rate of 18 Nov 2026, as reported in a web search summary. The RBA page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: Florianópolis was benchmarked against southern and southeastern Brazilian tourist and capital cities such as Porto Alegre and Curitiba, and against Rio de Janeiro off-peak. Search data puts the city about 15–27% above the Brazilian average.
